incident-bot: Pager alert — sudden spike in 5xxs for inference-prod endpoint /v1/generate. Canary rollout completed ~03:07 UTC; suspect model variant rev-2026-03-17-3. Paged @ashley_oncall.

ashley_oncall: Ack, I'm on it. Kicking off triage and checking canary telemetry.

sam_runtime: Seeing the same. I'm preparing a rollback route command in case we need to cut traffic.

ashley_oncall: Can you hold until I confirm customer impact? Also checking deploybot logs.

raj_sre: Logs show repeated tokenizer errors tied to model init: `TokenizerVocabError: unk_token not found in vocab` and weight load warnings referencing mismatched tokenizer package hash.

maria_prodops: Customer-facing impact: error rate peaked at ~3.4% of requests over the past 4m. Top affected orgs: AcmeCorp, DataFox — reports of truncated or malformed responses.

ashley_oncall: Decision: prepare emergency-firebreak. Plan = 1) flip model selection to stable 2) route traffic back to rev-2026-02-28-1 3) notify customers. Executing flag flip now.

ashley_oncall: Command (running):
```
# flip model-selector to stable
curl -XPOST https://ops-api.internal/flags/model-selector \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \n  -d '{"value":"stable"}'
```

sam_runtime: Traffic shift applied: `traffic-manager set-revision inference-prod rev-2026-02-28-1 --percent 100` — routing change accepted. Observability shows error rate dropping within 45s.

opsbot: Deploybot: rollback job queued (id: dj-8812). Promoting rev-2026-02-28-1 weights -> job started.

sam_runtime: Rollback promotion succeeded and health checks passed. Error rate back to baseline ~0.05%. Latency normalized.

nora_support: Customer comms: initial blurb sent to AcmeCorp & DataFox. Asking for any sample payloads — they confirmed transient failures and are awaiting formal update.

ashley_oncall: Preliminary root cause: automated artifact alias `weights-latest` pointed to a new quantized weight bundle, but tokenizer package promotion lags (tokenizer remained at v0.9.0 while weights expected v1.2.0 vocab). No preflight validation prevented mismatch.

raj_sre: Implemented short-term guard: promotion service now rejects artifact promotion if `vocab_hash` != `tokenizer.metadata.vocab_hash`. Patch pushed to staging and hotpatched to promotion API.

maria_prodops: Noting scope: traffic that hit the bad revision was ~18% of total in the 3m window — good that canary didn't fully prevent drift. Will itemize affected customers for SRE/CS handoff.

ashley_oncall: Filed incident stub in ops-tracker, tagging for postmortem and follow-ups (decouple aliasing, add tokenizer-weight preflight, stronger canary gate). Transfer to incident-review channel for RCA. :thumbsup:

incident-bot: Incident marked mitigated — suppression active. On-call handoff: @ashley_oncall -> @oncall_shift_lead at 03:40 UTC.

ashley_oncall: Handoff complete. I'll draft timeline and retain logs. Leaving follow-ups to SRE eng for fixes and CS for customer outreach.
